propositions: Pass-1 finder flags plan-vs-code discrepancy during execution-phase review when the plan's directed work has already been completed, causing false-positive blocks on correct tickets
Pass-2 needs a cohort-restricted veto to drop findings when the current code state satisfies the plan's end state goal during execution reviews only
The veto is enforced deterministically in orchestrator via cohort restriction to CODEBASE_GROUNDED (E4/G1G2/A1/G6), never firing for non-grounded findings or during planning reviews
A new na-default plan-review-only binary answer `current_state_satisfies_plan_goal` set by the verifier via present-state check gates the veto firing
The `execution_review` kwarg flows from orchestrator into pass3_decide and pass3_over_findings, defaulting False to preserve byte-unchanged behavior for planning and code-review calls
